answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 156345 Country: India Title: Can I drink Red Bull that is energy drink? Tell me is it haram or halal I am fully confused? Question: Can I drink Red Bull that is energy drink? Tell me is it haram or halal I am fully confused? Answer ID: 156345 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 170/129/SD=2/1439) According to Shariah, until it is not known about any drink for sure that it contains impure and haram thing it is allowed to drink it. But if something puts one in doubt then it is better to avoid it. The ruling shall apply the Red Bull. However, as per the research carried out by some institutions, the ingredients of original Red Bull are halal and pure but nothing can be said about duplicate Red Bull. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
